audit_items.proof_trace: The formula `simple_interest_factor.mul(borrow_index_prior).add(borrow_index_prior)` algebraically equals `index_prior * (1 + rate * dt)`: `mul_u64(rate, dt)` is exact (WAD cancels), and the single `mul` truncates by at most 1 WAD unit (< 1e-18 in real terms), which is standard fixed-point behavior. All callers route through the market.move helper (L1015-1028) that always uses the live `util_rate()` at accrual time; the zero-debt early-exit and same-timestamp guard are both consistent with dt=0 yielding no change.
